title: Chapter 5 - Goblin Interrogation and Dawn Raid Intelligence

content: Torgga interrogated goblin prisoner Krikk using seduction. Extracted critical intelligence: Dawn raid planned for first light (30+ goblins, 6 brutes led by Vrek Snapjaw targeting food stores). Zorzula's Rest has two entrances (well tunnel and hidden cave north of town). Critical weakness discovered: Shaman controls all psionic crystals - if shaman dies, all goblins lose powers.

Party decided to accelerate defenses on two fronts: (1) Urgent message to Zephyr to complete psionic disruptors BEFORE dawn (raid imminent), and (2) Alert Harbin to establish perimeter defenses with guard towers and archers around Phandalin.

Brevin delivers critical context to Zephyr: The goblins know about the disruptor research and are launching a preemptive strike with everything they have. This is no longer a rescue mission - it's annihilation. The dawn raid is an all-out assault to destroy Phandalin before the party can disable their psionic network.

CRITICAL ERROR: Party accidentally discussed disruptor plans and raid strategy within earshot of the second goblin prisoner. Due to psionic hive mind, ALL goblins at Zorzula's Rest now know: (1) Party is creating psionic disruptor devices, (2) Party plans to raid their lair, (3) Party knows about shaman weakness. The goblins will now come with EVERYTHING to annihilate the party and destroy the research before disruptors are completed. This is no longer a defensive battle - it's total war.

DM decision: Merging deviation with original campaign plan. The psionic crystals will be revealed to contain/be powered by obelisk shards. Vrek Snapjaw is Ruxithid the Chosen's field commander. After defending against the dawn raid, party will assault Zorzula's Rest to confront the true leader Ruxithid and discover the mind flayer connection.

Dawn raid arrived 8 hours early at 10 PM due to hive mind knowledge. 53 goblins attacking from three directions. Party strategy: Hold perimeter with militia, fortify town center around Zephyr's lab, rush to accelerate disruptor completion. No psionic disruptors available yet - must survive 1 hour.

Eglath orders Brevin to execute all goblin prisoners (Krikk and the second prisoner) in the townhall cells. Tactical reasoning: prisoners with hive mind connection could be coordinating with attackers or transmitting intelligence. Dark but strategic decision during siege.

Brevin executed both goblin prisoners in townhall cells, but must also eliminate the sedated commander in the old guardhouse. Commander is blindfolded (preventing location transmission) but still connected to hive mind. Killing him will sever coordination between attacking forces and their field leader.

Eglath activates Rage and charges the 4 Goblin Psi Brawlers attacking from the north. With commander dead and hive mind disrupted, goblins are disoriented. Eglath uses this advantage for brutal melee assault.

Party coordinates focus fire on 3 Goblin Psi Brawlers climbing south toward Brevin's rooftop position. Tactical decision to eliminate smallest group first and secure one flank. Brevin, Vandross, and Torgga all target south group.

Round 2: Torgga uses Healing Word on Eglath. Vandross and Brevin continue focus fire on the 3 Goblin Psi Brawlers scaling the wall toward Brevin's rooftop position (1 wounded at 5 HP, 2 healthy at 31 HP each). Climbers are 10 feet from reaching the rooftop.

Eglath abandons his fight with 3 northern brawlers to protect Brevin. Rushes toward south wall and attempts to climb up to intercept the 2 remaining brawlers (6 feet from reaching Brevin's rooftop). Heroic but risky - will provoke opportunity attacks from enemies he's leaving behind.

Party executes tactical fallback to apothecary doorway. Main goblin force (9 Psi Brawlers + 5 regulars) has broken through militia line and is 20 feet from lab. Party consolidates position at doorway to create defensive chokepoint and protect Zephyr's research. 16 minutes until disruptors complete.

Desperate defense at apothecary doorway. Vandross yells at Zephyr to accelerate. Party executes coordinated strike: Torgga casts Spirit Guardians (Level 3 spell, creating radiant damage zone), Brevin focus fires from rooftop, Vandross and Eglath engage front line melee. Chokepoint tactics maximizing effectiveness.

Round 4: Party holds defensive position at doorway. Goblins must advance through Spirit Guardians zone to reach party. Brevin prepares improvised incendiary (oil flask with lit cloth) to throw at clustered goblins when they reach the doorway. Defensive chokepoint strategy combined with area denial.

Round 5: Torgga uses Healing Word (bonus action) on Eglath who has taken significant damage (30/65 HP). Spirit Guardians concentration maintained. Party continues defending doorway chokepoint against 5 wounded goblins with 10+ waiting behind.

Ammunition tracking initiated. Brevin started combat with 20 arrows (standard quiver). Arrows used so far: 3 (Round 3: killed South Brawler 1, Round 4: oil bomb throw (no arrow), Round 5: killed Brawler 1). Current ammunition: 17 arrows remaining.

Round 6: Split strategy. Vandross and Eglath engage 2 remaining goblins at doorway (Brawlers 3 & 4, 12 HP each). Brevin targets Vrek Snapjaw (field commander) with longshot arrow to break goblin morale. Torgga maintains Spirit Guardians concentration.
Round 7: Torgga casts Cure Wounds Level 3 on Eglath during Dawn Raid defense
